interpretation: R3.1 qualified the mechanics of allowing distributional Teacher gradients to reshape a disposable Shared Decision Core. On the single pre-registered seed, the disposable shared-core arm reduced both distributional validation loss and the existing canonical Direction/Requested-Risk validation loss, but changed hypothetical direction on 26 of 72 validation contexts. This is architecture evidence only and is insufficient for production cutover.
r3_2_purpose: Test whether the R3.1 shared-core effect is stable across a fixed pre-registered seed set and measure initial Shared-Core gradient geometry between the distributional action-law objective and the existing canonical Direction/Requested-Risk objective.
